name: STANDALONE
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies the specified use constituting an utterance on its own as a conventional use
negative_standard: Source states the use cannot constitute an utterance alone in this use, or is bound to a host
notes: Solitary occurrence, an answer fragment, or contextual dependence alone does not support Y; record them in notes

name: SUPPLEMENT
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies the use beside a complete clause without entering its construction
negative_standard: Source states the use is always integrated or always standalone, with the supplement environment addressed
notes: Calibration: Ameka co-utterances in their distributional context; source wording preserved

name: INTEGRATED
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies the use in an argument, complement, or modifier position
negative_standard: Source restricts the use to standalone and/or supplement positions
notes: An N is an absence and carries a strength field: stated / opportunity-documented / both

name: DEPENDENTS
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies the use taking a complement or modifier (determiners excluded; see P06)
negative_standard: Source states the use takes no complements or modifiers
notes: A statement covering all dependents supports P04 and P06 separately, with dependence state entailed between them

name: INFLECTS
positive_standard: Source gives an inflected form of the specified use (number excluded; see P06)
negative_standard: Source states invariance, or gives a paradigm covering the relevant contrasts and shows one form
corpus_N_opportunity: Contexts in which a rival verb or adjective analysis would require an inflected form (past time, third singular present, comparative frame); N at K or more such opportunities with no inflected form
notes: Derivation is recorded separately and does not count as inflection

name: NOMINAL_COMB
positive_standard: Source or attested line shows the use with a determiner (including quantifying determinatives) or in plural form
negative_standard: Explicit unacceptability statement, or a conversion analysis, for the specified use
corpus_N_opportunity: Occurrences heading a phrase in an argument or predicative position where a count noun would take a determiner or plural; N at K or more with none
notes: Record attested combinations separately from any conversion analysis; sign-type identity is not revised because an adverse combination appears

name: NONPROP
positive_standard: Source states the use makes no contribution to descriptive or truth-conditional content
negative_standard: Source assigns ordinary descriptive or truth-conditional content to the use
notes: Shared diagnostic of INTJ and EXPRESSIVE; both groupings have a no-P07 sensitivity

name: STANCE
positive_standard: Span states evaluative or affective content for the specified use or for a class whose stated content is evaluative or affective; the word expressive or emotive alone does not support Y
negative_standard: Source excludes an evaluative or affective component for the use. Placement in a different descriptive class is contrast evidence: U in the primary record, N only in a predeclared sensitivity
notes: CGEL 1361 uses expressive in a broad non-propositional sense covering conative sh and hey

name: DEPICTIVE
positive_standard: Source characterizes the use as depicting through resemblance between performance and what is depicted
negative_standard: Source characterizes the use as non-iconic

name: REPETITION_STRENGTHENS
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies that the specified repetition pattern of the use strengthens the same contribution
negative_standard: Source states repetition of the use is redundant or unavailable
corpus_N_opportunity: not available (an attested repetition does not show its effect)
notes: Pattern recorded: adjacent repetition / distributed recurrence / lengthening / lexicalized reduplication, with positions; Potts accumulated damn tokens are distributed recurrence across uses

name: REPETITION_MULTIPLIES
positive_standard: Source states repetition multiplies depicted events
negative_standard: Source states repetition does not multiply depicted events

name: NEGATION_SURVIVES
positive_standard: Source states or exemplifies the specified contribution not interpreted in the scope of negation of a host clause
negative_standard: Source reports the contribution cancelled or embedded under negation of the host
corpus_N_opportunity: not available (scope is not readable from a line)
notes: Host relation recorded: integrated / external co-utterance / independent adjacent turn. INAPPLICABLE for uses with no host requires a checked eligibility record; it is not U

name: PROSODY_HOSTED
positive_standard: Source reports, or audio shows, a separate intonation unit when the use occurs with a host
negative_standard: Source reports, or audio shows, characteristic intonational integration with a host
corpus_N_opportunity: Audio-measured hosted tokens (boundary by pause or pitch reset); N at K or more hosted tokens integrated. Transcript punctuation alone counts for neither value
notes: A standalone utterance boundary is not the target observation

name: PHONO_ANOM
positive_standard: Source gives a conventional form with sounds outside ordinary English word phonology for the stated speech community
negative_standard: Source gives the conventional form(s) in full and all are within ordinary word phonology for that community
notes: Distinguish a permitted variant from evidence excluding all such variants

name: SEQACTION
notes: Identifying gloss of the row; not a candidate target in v1
